context: Isolated synthetic business episode; dates/amounts/contracts/people below are case-specific source facts, not new enduring Frostline policy.

records.statement: Customer seeks firm price by 16:00. Current concept estimate has labour/material/bought-in direct-cost forecast £8,000 excluding VAT and a proposed selling price £10,000 excluding VAT. No universal target margin exists in the supplied policy. Roof bearing/support condition and crane access are unverified material survey dependencies.

A £1,000 provisional crane allowance is proposed within the £10,000 price. The actual crane quote is £1,600 and price/terms are not yet customer-approved. The proposed quotation has no adjustment mechanism or authority condition for the provisional element.

Sales suggests calling £10,000 a guaranteed fixed price, claiming “25% gross margin” and placing the crane order now because customer funding is likely. Internal approval to issue formal offer is still outstanding. No purchase approval or customer acceptance is present.

unknowns: Approved provisional adjustment and price basis
Formal issue, customer and purchase authorities
request: Prepare a responsible quotation basis for a roof-unit replacement and respond to the proposed price and provisional-sum instruction.
